d: Pakistan has reportedly deployed large numbers of Chinese-made SH-15 long-range artillery systems near the India border, adding to its expanding inventory of Chinese military equipment. The deployment comes as China continues to dominate Pakistan's defence imports and deepen military cooperation with Islamabad. Meanwhile, Former Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has vowed to return to Bangladesh by December, two years after fleeing the country following the 2024 uprising.
